title: Protests in Delhi Demand Statehood for Jammu and Kashmir
summary: Hundreds of people protested in Delhi, demanding the restoration of statehood for Jammu and Kashmir. CPM leader Tarigami expressed support for the protest and reiterated the demand. The demonstration highlights ongoing calls for political changes in the region.
summary_points: Hundreds protested in Delhi demanding statehood for Jammu and Kashmir.
CPM leader Tarigami backed the protest and reiterated the demand.
The protest focused on the political status of Jammu and Kashmir.
The event signifies ongoing calls for restored statehood in the region.
